statement.notes: The only field requested for extraction from the provided schema is 'depreciation_and_amortization'. This value is directly and clearly provided as a single line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for each year. No combination of other elements is required. The supplementary tables contain related information (e.g., operating lease details) but do not provide alternative or component values for the consolidated depreciation and amortization figure reported in the primary statement.
